doc: CutsceneSequencer tuning (M2-FP-01; docs/kb/tech/cutscenes.md). Times in seconds, distances in metres, sizes as a fraction of the screen height. music_stand_ins maps a cue's track id to an existing file under music_dir until Audio ships the real cue (placeholders for the first playable; nobody has approved them as final). vfx rows give the placeholder mote look per @vfx effect (colours from docs/kb/tech/glimmer.md). skip_hold_sec: how long ui_cancel is held to skip (a skip fast-forwards to the next choice or the end); skip_prompt: the 'hold to skip' fill, bottom right. face_poses: actor id -> a face-poses JSON (emotion -> blend shape weights; Character's file, read only) used by @face and by each line's [emotion]. lip_flap: blend shape weights held while DialogueBox reports the mouth open. clips: the AnimationPlayer clip played per role (idle, talk, walk, run) when the actor's rig has it. key_light (M2-FP-10; cutscenes.md 'Key light'): on dialogue and portrait framing (a shot whose frame is at most close_half_frame_m tall above and below its aim) the cast is lit by a short-range copy of the zone sun instead of the sun itself: render layer `layer` holds the cast meshes while it is on, and the shadow values follow character_shading.md 'Shadows on characters'.
